title: Schedule of Account Charges, Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing
content:
This schedule lists the charge figures of each Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing plan: the late fee figures and the late-fee grace period, the courtesy waiver allowance, the returned payment fee and the phone payment fee. Column heads give the plan names without the common "Ridgeline" prefix.

## Charge figures by plan

| | Same-As-Cash 12 | Same-As-Cash 18 | Zero-Interest Equal Pay 24 | Fixed-Rate 60 | Fixed-Rate 120 | Low-Payment 144 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Late-fee grace period after a due date (calendar days) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Fixed late fee, before the percentage limit (USD) | 29.00 | 29.00 | 29.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 39.00 |
| Late fee percentage limit (share of the scheduled payment that was late) | 5% | 5% | 5% | 5% | 5% | 5% |
| Courtesy late-fee waivers in any rolling 365 days | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 |
| On-time statement periods required immediately before the late one for a courtesy waiver | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Returned payment fee (USD) | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 | 30.00 |
| Phone payment fee (USD) | 9.95 | 9.95 | 9.95 | 7.95 | 7.95 | 7.95 |
| Phone payment fee waived while an approved hardship deferral is in effect | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The phone payment fee is the fee for a payment made through a phone agent; payments by autopay, through the online portal and by mail are free on every plan.
2. The percentage limit means a late fee never exceeds 5% of the scheduled payment that was late.
3. The description of the fixed late fee as the figure before the percentage limit, and of the percentage limit as a ceiling, is that of the base late fee. For a late fee on an account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), the current late fee assessment basis governs, and the late fee may exceed the stated share.
4. The phone payment fee shown is the plan's flat fee under the base fee; for a payment taken through a phone agent, the current agent-assisted phone payment fee basis governs, and the flat fee is its standard amount.
5. The grace period is counted in calendar days after the due date.

## Points of reading

- Ridgeline Low-Payment 144 has both the highest fixed late fee (39.00) and the largest courtesy allowance (2 waivers in any rolling 365 days).
- The three promotional plans share a 10-day grace period; the three fixed-rate and low-payment plans share a 15-day grace period.
